title: Bilirubin, direct (conjugated)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Direct (conjugated) bilirubin is bilirubin that the liver has already processed so it can leave the body in bile. It is one part of total bilirubin.
context: Some medicines, certain foods and strenuous exercise can affect bilirubin. Direct bilirubin is usually read together with total and indirect bilirubin and other liver tests.
aboveRange: A blockage in the bile ducts
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
